sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.client_id)
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_anc_card a
                     FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results b
         INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp ON a.client_id = mdp.patient_id
         INNER JOIN (SELECT b.client_id, b.test_value
                     WHERE b.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND b.encounter_datetime < :endDate
                       AND b.test_value ='AB NEGATIVE'
                       AND b.test_parameter = 'BLOOD TYPING') blooding_grouping
                    ON blooding_grouping.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE a.encounter_date >= :startDate AND a.encounter_date < :endDate
